data.one_liner: Native Flutter PDF editor and viewer with text selection, annotations, forms, and signatures.
data.what_it_does: Provides drop-in Flutter widgets for viewing, searching, and editing PDF documents entirely rendered in Dart. Supports annotations, digital signatures, form filling, page splitting, and document comparison across multiple platforms.
use_when: You need a pure-Dart PDF viewer or full-featured editor inside a Flutter app.
You need cross-platform PDF rendering without relying on native platform views or external PDF libraries.
avoid_when: You need absolute PDFium performance parity on all target devices.
You want to avoid external assets or opt-in packages for extended font and web rendering support.
strengths: Complete PDF editing and viewing suite written natively in Dart.
Supports annotations, incremental saves, form filling, redaction, and digital signatures.
Works across iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, and the web.
weaknesses: Default viewer has not reached complete PDFium interaction parity yet.
Bundled fonts and web worker require an optional companion package to avoid missing advanced typography features.
data.setup_notes: Add the package via pub add. Optionally add dart_pdf_editor_assets and call registerBundledEditorAssets() at startup for full fonts and web worker support.
